title: File:Carte Cambodge et Siam Itineraires de Auguste Pavie 1880-1884.jpg
author: Auguste Jean-Marie Pavie (1847 - 1925)
description: French map, title: 'Itinéraires de Mr. A. Pavie dans le sud-ouest de L'Indo-Chine Orientale (Cambodge et Siam) (1880 - 1884).' Size: 106.68 x 129.54 cm. Scale: 1 : 460000. This maps shows Battambang province, Koh Kong Province, and Siem Reap province were part of Siam (Thailand) in 1884. Angkor Thom was also a Siamese city.
